Alex: quick heads-up — ran the nightly perf job against the continuous-batcher with the new kernel-selector heuristics. p95 tail for the short-prompt cohort jumped ~28ms when KV hit rate dipped below ~84%.
Jem: can you paste the profiler snippets / perf counters? curious if it's a decode-path or kernel flip.
Alex: here are trimmed traces from the run:
```
2026-03-16T03:12:11Z INFO enqueue id=3f7 kernel_choice=matmul_opt KV_hit=0.81 batch_sz=7 avg_tokens=32
2026-03-16T03:12:12Z WARN KERNEL_SWITCH reason=kv_eviction from=matmul_opt to=matmul_fallback
2026-03-16T03:12:12Z DEBUG decode_rate=320 tok/s window=50ms
```
p95 samples show an extra 20–40ms right after KERNEL_SWITCH events.
Ravi: looks like the classifier is labeling some sessions as "fast-decode" using instantaneous tokens/sec. instant spikes are causing us to under-allocate token_budget, batches complete earlier and then eviction hits cause kernel_flip. I think we should compute decode_rate as an EWMA (tau ~200ms) and bucket based on percentile boundaries, not raw instantaneous.
Sasha: also seeing that KV prefetch/evict interplay matters: when eviction happens mid-batch kernel flips to the slower path. Suggest tagging batches with `kv_stable=true` if recent KV_miss_rate < 0.1 and delaying dispatch for low-arrival cohorts to avoid partial eviction churn.
Toni: token-budget proposal (starting point):
- short prompt bucket (<64 tokens): token_budget=1536
- mid (64-256): token_budget=3072
- long (256+): token_budget=8192
Also set dynamic cap: token_budget = min(8192, max(base, expected_tokens * 1.2)).
Alex: good. If we combine EWMA decode_rate + these budget targets we might reduce kernel_switch_count. Need to A/B.
perf-bot: perf-bot: CI alert: regression detected on commit abc1234 — continuous-batcher/nightly p95 +6.2% on 8xA100.
Jem: I'll spin a canary with two changes: (1) classifier -> EWMA(200ms) for decode_rate and new percentile bucket boundaries, (2) queue policy = hold-to-fill for cohorts with low arrival_rate and expected_tokens > token_budget * 0.6. Will collect these metrics: p50/p95/p99, kernel_switch_count, kv_miss_rate, avg_batch_size, cost_per_token.
Ravi: also add a histogram of decode_rate at enqueue time and a timeseries for kernel_switches per-minute so we can correlate.
Sasha: small logging tweak: include `KERNEL_SWITCH reason=kv_miss prev_kernel=matmul_opt` in structured logs so we can filter quickly.
Toni: test plan: canary 10% traffic for 6h -> if stable 30% for 12h -> roll. success criteria: p95 within 2% of baseline, kernel_switch_count down 30%, cost_per_token within ±3%.
Alex: I'll draft a short RFC with the config keys and rollout steps. Thanks all — Jem, ping me when the canary is up.
Jem: will do. starting now. :thumbsup
